title: Emoji-status switch moves before the send and is not put back when the send fails
trigger: Open a mini app's permission box, flip 'allow emoji status' while the client cannot send (closing, native send error).
effect: The bot's can_manage_emoji_status stays flipped though no request went out and no error answer will ever restore it (apply_web_app_error is the only rollback).
fix: Stage the change as a pending request with a RequestRollback (as set_forum_topic_muted does), or flip only after a successful send.

title: A new launch clears the unconsumed open result without closing the app TDLib already started
trigger: Open mini app A; its answer lands in open_result as Opened{launch_id}; before the UI poll takes it (or while its window is locked/refused) open mini app B.
effect: mark_web_app_pending sets open_result=None (and finish_web_app_open overwrites it) without pushing A's launch_id to dropped_launches, so closeWebApp is never sent for A and the bot keeps a live session.
fix: Make open results a per-request map or queue keyed by RequestId, and route every discarded Opened through dropped_launches.

title: Mini-app launch is a Vec of pending contexts plus single one-shot Option slots
trigger: n/a
effect: Launch stage is spread over WebApps::pending, open_result, dropped_launches and the one-shot found/write_access/emoji_access/phone_share/data_sent/attachment_menu_* slots, each cleared by hand at the start of the next call.
fix: One enum per flow (Launch{Pending(RequestId,ctx)|Opened|Failed|Dropped}) keyed by request id; grossing_loading becomes Fetch<Vec<i64>>.

title: Transfer-card lookup answer is not matched to the transaction that was asked for
trigger: In the open Money page click a transfer card for transaction A, then another card for transaction B before A answers.
effect: tx_loading is one bool and the Transaction answer is matched by purpose only, so A's answer shows A's details and clears tx_loading; B's answer is then dropped. The user sees the wrong transfer.
fix: TxLookup enum {Idle, Loading(tx_id), Failed(id, text)} and apply the answer only when its id equals the Loading id.

title: Wallet one-shot request flags are set before the send and some are never cleared on failure
trigger: Open the Money page while the send fails (state_requested/rates_requested stay true), or while getApplicationConfig is refused by TDLib.
effect: state_requested and rates_requested stay true after a failed send, and explorer_url_requested has no error arm at all, so the Gram USD rate and explorer address are never asked again this session and the fiat value shows a dash.
fix: Fetch<T> per resource (rates, explorer config, own state) with Failed re-askable on the next Money page open.

title: Paged<T> and MoneyPage keep loading/loaded/error as separate fields
trigger: n/a
effect: History and NFT lists carry loading, loaded and error that apply()/fail() keep in step; MoneyPage::close/open resets the whole page while an earlier page request is still in flight, so its late answer lands in the new page (append onto an empty list).
fix: Paged<T> holds a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading{append}/Ready/Failed) and a page token compared with the answer.

title: Re-requesting insights while statistics are in flight fetches the first forwards page again and appends it
trigger: Open insights for own story A; its forwards page answers first; reopen insights for A while getStoryStatistics is still pending.
effect: The pending-stats branch sees no forwards request in flight and calls fetch_story_public_forwards(offset empty); accept_public_forwards extends the list, so the first page of public forwards shows twice.
fix: Ask for the first page only when the forwards fetch is Idle; make forwards a Fetch with the offset it was asked for and replace on offset 0.

title: A failed send of the next search page throws away all search results
trigger: Scroll a public story search to its end and trigger Load more when the sender refuses the request.
effect: send_story_search_page calls clear_story_search on any send error, so the open results panel and its pages vanish instead of showing a retryable error.
fix: On a send error settle the page as Failed (search.error, loading cleared) and keep the pages.

title: Story insights and search state kept as loading bool plus error plus request
trigger: n/a
effect: StoryInsightsState has forwards_loading beside forwards_error; StorySearchState has loading beside error and an Option<RequestId> that is the real stage; load_more flips loading before the send decides whether a request goes out.
fix: StorySearchState::page: Fetch{Idle|Loading(RequestId)|Failed}; same for forwards.

title: Staged close-friends list is one Option not matched to the request
trigger: Save the close-friends list twice quickly (A then B) and let the first request fail.
effect: close_friends_pending holds only the latest list; A's error clears B's staged ids, so B's ok applies nothing and the list on screen stays stale although the server has B.
fix: Stage the list on the PendingRequest (or a map by RequestId) and apply it on that request's ok.

title: Story viewers panel loading flag is set after the send by the driver
trigger: n/a
effect: StoryViewersState::loading/error/next_offset are kept in step with the GetStoryInteractions request by the driver and two reducer arms.
fix: Fetch-style enum with the offset requested, set in one place.

title: Suggest bar is removed as soon as the send goes out, before the answer
trigger: Edit a suggested post with new price/time, send the change, and let TDLib refuse it (balance, permissions).
effect: The bar (terms the user set) is dropped on send success; the error arm only adds a note, so the terms must be entered again.
fix: Keep the bar until the request answers; remove it in the ok arm and keep it on error.

title: Proxy auto-switch and system-proxy follow run only for the account on screen
trigger: Sign in two accounts, set Use system proxy (or a proxy list with rotation) on account B, switch to account A, then change the OS proxy or kill B's proxy.
effect: The Background tick scope returns before proxy_tick/system_proxy_tick, so B's TDLib client keeps the dead or old proxy, stops receiving messages and notifications until B is shown again.
fix: Run proxy_tick and system_proxy_tick for both scopes (they are per-driver), keep only UI-bound ticks on-screen.

title: Video-note story reply runs ffmpeg synchronously on the UI thread
trigger: Record a round video as a story reply and press Send (ui/story_viewer/reply_media.rs:457 calls this inside this.update_in).
effect: write_video_note_thumbnail waits for ffmpeg (up to PROBE_LIMIT*3 = 30 s) on the main thread; the whole window freezes during the wait, and with a hung ffmpeg for half a minute.
fix: Make the thumbnail with the capture finish on the background task and pass it in the draft; the driver only sends.

title: parameters_sent bool shadows the auth state it follows
trigger: n/a
effect: ConnectDriver::parameters_sent is set after setTdlibParameters is sent and gates both maybe_send_parameters and network_tick; the real stage is session.auth (WaitTdlibParameters, StartupFailed on error), so two values are kept in step.
fix: Handshake enum {NotSent, Sent(RequestId)} owned with the auth state, or derive from auth and the pending SetParameters request.

title: Draft save is a clock, a token, and an Option that must change together
trigger: n/a
effect: draft_clock, draft_save_token and pending_draft (token, chat, topic, content) are updated by hand in several driver methods; same shape for search_debounce_token with pending_typed_search and chat_search_debounce_token with pending_typed_chat_search.
fix: A Debounce<T> value {Idle|Armed{token,value}} that owns the token.

title: Thread open stage is status plus needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed
trigger: n/a
effect: ThreadView::status, needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed are set in step by switch_to_thread_chat, begin_thread_reading, fetch_thread_history and the reducer; the UI polls thread_needs_start each frame to decide which step is due.
fix: ThreadStage enum {Resolving, SwitchingChat, Starting, Loading, Ready, Failed} with reload as a Ready sub-variant.

title: Auto-download prefs: seeded bool beside an external loading flag and an error
trigger: n/a
effect: 'Loading…' is derived from DataStoragePrefs::seeded plus SettingsState::auto_download_presets_loading plus data_storage_error; storage_limits_seeded is a second one-way stage flag.
fix: Fetch<DataStoragePrefs> for the presets seed; persist only the seeded values.

title: Ninth queued external link is dropped silently and reported as accepted
trigger: While the UI is busy or locked, open nine different tg:// links from the OS.
effect: push_external_link returns true and raises the window, but links past MAX_QUEUED are not queued; the user gets no word that the link was ignored.
fix: Return a result enum {Queued, Duplicate, Full} and tell the user when the inbox is full.

title: A timed-out export request leaves WorkerLink::pending set, so its late answer is handed to the worker's next call
trigger: Run a full account export with several chats; one chat's getChatHistory/searchChatMessages/download takes over 300 s (QUERY_TIMEOUT) to answer. ChannelTdlib::call returns Tdlib("the request timed out"), export_chats counts that chat as failed and carries on (account/worker.rs:482). The driver still has pending=Some(A) and forwards nothing else; when A's answer arrives WorkerLink::reply sends it down the id-less replies channel, where the next chat's first call takes it as its own answer.
effect: The next chat is exported with the previous chat's messages (or every later answer is shifted by one), so a chat folder holds another chat's content under the wrong name; later calls misparse until the export ends.
fix: Make the reply channel carry the RequestId and have ChannelTdlib::call discard replies that are not its own request; on timeout also clear/abandon the link's pending entry (an enum ExportCall {Idle, Awaiting(RequestId), Abandoned(RequestId)}).

title: WorkerLink lifecycle is spread over pending: Option<RequestId>, an AtomicBool cancelled and an 'ended' channel whose disconnect means done
trigger: Any chat or account export: running() = !cancelled && !ended, idle_or_cancelled() = pending.is_none() || cancelled, and the UI separately reads Progress.stage (Finished/Failed/Cancelled) written by the worker thread.
effect: Four independent signals (link.pending, link.cancelled, link.ended, progress.stage) must agree; they disagree after a worker panic or a request timeout (see 03-P3-001 and 03-P3-003).
fix: One ExportRun enum owned by the session (Starting, Running{awaiting}, Cancelling, Ended(outcome)) written by the pump and by a worker-ended notice, with progress as data inside Running.

title: An export worker that panics ends without publishing a settled stage; the progress box never gets Done
trigger: The account (or chat) export worker thread panics inside spawn_guarded (any future indexing/unwrap bug, or the debug_assert in ResultJson::field in debug builds). guarded() swallows it, the closure's trailing publish(Failed) never runs, only the alive sender drops.
effect: Progress stays at e.g. 'Chats: 3 of 40' for ever, the Done button (only shown when settled) never appears, a new export is refused with 'already running', and every Quit shows 'Stop and quit?'. worker_ended() is not read anywhere outside tests to settle it.
fix: Settle on worker end: a drop guard in the thread body that publishes Failed('stopped unexpectedly') when no final stage was written, or poll worker_ended() and map it to a Failed stage.

title: A failed or cancelled account export leaves a truncated, unterminated result.json and no export_results.html
trigger: Start a JSON-format account export of many chats, press Cancel (or lose the connection so a section call fails) midway.
effect: The DataExport folder keeps result.json cut off mid-array (ResultJson::finish and the index page are only written on the success path), so a later tool reading it fails or silently sees a partial export, and the folder holds private account data with no marker that it is incomplete.
fix: On Err/Cancel finish the ResultJson (close arrays) or write an 'incomplete' marker; better, write to result.json.part and rename on success.

title: Two installs of the same emoji set share one temp folder and one .old folder, so overlapping installs corrupt each other
trigger: Start downloading set X, press Download X again (the first download is cancelled but its worker is already inside unpack), or run 'Install from file' for X while a download of X is finishing.
effect: Both unpack calls use '.<name>.<pid>.part' and '.<name>.old': one remove_dir_all wipes the other's half-extracted files, so the install fails with 'damaged'/'Couldn't save' or the .old rollback restores the wrong pack.
fix: Name the temp folder with a per-call serial (as copy::part_path does) or serialise installs per EmojiSetId.

title: EmojiStyleUi keeps the download stage as started: bool plus download, download_task, failed, file_task and file_error Options, and detects cancel by comparing the message to "Cancelled."
trigger: Open Emoji set, start a download, start another (replaces it), install from file while one runs.
effect: download/download_task/failed/file_error must be cleared together by hand in download_emoji_set, install_emoji_set_file and the completion callbacks; the cancel arm is recognised by a string equal to download::fetch's literal.
fix: enum SetStage {Idle, Downloading{id, progress, task}, Failed{id, message}, Installing{task}} and a typed DownloadError::Cancelled instead of String.

title: A flood-retry re-send that fails drops an export request via settle_lost_request, which never clears the export link's pending
trigger: During an export a getChatHistory gets a 429 (retained and retried), and the re-send's send_json fails (TDLib closing / connection teardown).
effect: settle_lost_request feeds a generic error to the reducer, not to WorkerLink::reply, so link.pending stays Some(id): idle_or_cancelled() is false and no further export request is forwarded; the worker waits out QUERY_TIMEOUT per call.
fix: Route ExportAccount/ExportChat/ExportRichHtml lost requests to link.fail_send (or reply with an error) in settle_lost_request.

title: FilterDraft::open drops stored administrators that are no longer in the admin list and can open with none ticked
trigger: Filter Recent actions by one admin, remove that admin's rights, reopen the filter box.
effect: The stored filter has stored_admins=[X] but all_admins excludes X, so draft.admins is empty: 'All admins' and every admin box show unticked and Save is disabled until the user ticks something, while the log still filters by X.
fix: Keep stored ids in the draft even when they are not in the current list, or treat an empty intersection as 'all admins'.

title: Folder editor closes and toasts 'Folder updated/created' when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Open Edit Folder (or New Folder), choose a state the server refuses (name TDLib rejects, a limit the local check does not know such as FILTER_*_TOO_MUCH / DIALOG_FILTERS_TOO_MUCH, or go offline), press Save.
effect: save_folder_editor sets folders.editor = None and shows the silent 'Folder updated' note as soon as driver.edit_chat_folder/create_chat_folder returns Ok(request id). The failure arrives later through state::domains::chat_list::error (limit box or generic error) after the editor and its typed input are gone, so the person sees a success note followed by an error and loses the edits.
fix: Keep the editor as a Saving(request) stage of one enum (Editing, Saving(RequestId), Failed(text)); close it only on the matching answer and show the error inside it.

title: FolderEditor saves a snapshot of the folder spec taken when the box opened, overwriting later pin/include/exclude changes
trigger: Open Edit Folder (getChatFolder answered, editor prefilled from_spec), then while the box is open the folder changes (a chat is pinned in the folder from another window or device, a chat is removed through the remove-from-folder chain, the shared folder adds chats), then press Save.
effect: to_spec sends the old pinned_chat_ids, included/excluded sets and color_id in editChatFolder, silently undoing the newer change. ChatList already tracks folder_specs_stale so edits start from a fresh spec for removals, but the editor ignores it.
fix: Store the editor's base spec with its fetch generation as part of one stage enum and, on Save, refetch (or merge only the fields the person touched) when folder_specs_stale contains the folder.

title: Archive build error note is shown in whatever chat is open, and the 'Preparing the archive' note is never settled when the person moved on
trigger: Drop a large folder on the 'Send as archive' zone in chat A, switch to chat B (same account) before zipping ends and let the build fail (too large, unreadable file), or let it succeed.
effect: archive_ready checks send_slot() only in the Ok arm; the Err arm sets an error StatusNote for the current chat B, and the Ok-but-moved-on early return leaves the earlier 'Preparing the archive' note unreplaced until it times out. No in-flight marker exists, so a second drop starts a second zip.
fix: Make the archive job a stage value keyed by SendSlot (Building(slot) -> Ready/Failed) owned by the slot's composer state, and apply both arms only when the key still matches.
